# Dhilip Studio — Editorial Wedding Photography in Chennai

> Dhilip Studio is a premium wedding photography studio based in Porur, Chennai, specializing in candid wedding photography, traditional Brahmin rituals, pre & post-wedding shoots, maternity monographs, and birthday milestone celebrations.

## Core Pages & Services
- [Home Page](https://dhilipstudio.com/): Overview of services, client reviews, 3D monograph showcases, and booking information.
- [About Us](https://dhilipstudio.com/about): Our story, vision, 12+ years of experience, team, and photography philosophy.
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://dhilipstudio.com/gallery): Full collection of 500+ candid wedding monographs and ritual celebrations.
- [Videos & Cinematography](https://dhilipstudio.com/videos): 4K wedding films, teaser reels, and aerial drone monographs.
- [Blog & Journal](https://dhilipstudio.com/blog): Wedding planning tips, candid photography guides, and South Indian ritual insights.
- [Contact Us & Booking](https://dhilipstudio.com/contact): Studio location map, inquiry form, WhatsApp contact, and session booking.
